data.title: Counting in Groups with Bears!
data.description: Learn how to count objects arranged in equal groups using friendly bears.

challenges.instruction: Can you count all the bears in the groups?
challenges.hint: Try counting the bears in each group one by one!
challenges.narration: Let us count these lovely bears together by looking at the groups.

challenges.instruction: Count the bears in these groups to find the total!
challenges.hint: Count how many bears are in one group, then add the next group.
challenges.narration: Look at these new groups of bears. Can you count them all?

challenges.instruction: How many bears are hiding in these groups?
challenges.hint: Count each group carefully to get the total number of bears.
challenges.narration: Here are more bears in neat groups. Let us count them up!

challenges.instruction: Can you find the total number of bears in these groups?
challenges.hint: Take your time and count the bears in each circle.
challenges.narration: You are doing great! Let us count this group of bears together.

challenges.instruction: Count the final set of groups to finish the adventure!
challenges.hint: Count every bear in every group to find the final number.
challenges.narration: This is our last challenge. Let us count all the bears to win!
